title: Bouncy Orb
description: Replaces the experience orb with the Bouncy Ball from Garry's Mod.
body:
## Bouncy Orb Pack

Replaces the standard **XP Orbs** with the **Bouncy Balls** from Garry's Mod. Bright, recognizable textures retain the original's style.

This pack only changes the XP Orb's appearance without affecting gameplay. Compatible with most versions of Minecraft and other resource packs.
